description: Take every dinner off a week and keep the plan, so it can be planned again at once. Days already passed and evenings out stay; a locked day stays unless includeLocked is true. The shopping list loses the recipe lines and keeps what the household added by hand. Ask the member first: only the Week page's «Angre» right after a clear in the app brings the dinners back.

includeLocked.description: True only when the household has said the locked days go too.

weekStart.description: Any date in the week; resolved to that week's plan.

name: clear_week
title: Clear the week
